neighbours.label: ' in' in 'move/point/head in a (certain) direction', the preposition that introduces a direction
fire: After the election, the party began drifting in a more moderate direction.
Every signpost on the hiking trail points in the same direction.
The current pushed our small canoe in the opposite direction.
Her latest research is heading in an unexpected direction.
Near the magnet the compass needle swung in the wrong direction.
The coach says the team is finally moving in the right direction.
Startled pigeons scattered in every direction at once.
The explosion threw debris in all directions across the yard.
quiet: After the election, the party began meeting in a more modest building.
Every signpost on the hiking trail is painted in the same colour.
The current was strongest in the morning near our small canoe.
Her latest research is published in an unexpected journal.
The compass was kept in the wrong drawer next to the magnet.
The coach says the team is finally playing in the right stadium.
Startled pigeons were nesting in every gap of the roof.
After the explosion, debris lay in all corners of the yard.

notes: Card: all top 32 peaks are ' in' before 'the/a/any ... direction(s)'; the logit effect promotes ' direction', ' opposite', 'wards'.
